title: West Pakistan Land Revenue Sindh Second Amendment Act 1972

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Land Revenue Sindh Second Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 1972
ACT XV OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (SIND SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
At
Act further to amend the West Pakistan Sind Revenue Act, 1967, in its
application to the Province of Sind.
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 8th
December 1972]
(First published
after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated the 8th December 1972).
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Second Amendment)
Act, 1972.
(2) It shall be
deemed to have come into force on and from the 20th day of March 1972.

2. Amendment of section 164 of West
Pakistan Act XVII of 1967. In the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, in
its application to the Province of Sind, in section 164-
(6) in
subsection (3), for the word "Commissioner", the words "Board of
Revenue" shall be substituted I
